remarks: Welcome to Your New Home at 29 Van Buren Ave, Unit #K4!  Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this beautiful first-floor unit - no stairs required! Enjoy ample closet space, in-unit washer and dryer, and a reserved parking space, all designed to make everyday living effortless. You're just minutes from The SoNo Collection, South Norwalk Train Station, Stew Leonard's, Wegmans, Target, and more.  Come see why Unit #K4 is the talk of the town - we can't wait to welcome you home!
